# A handler in a run-time instance's content reads the content's own loop
# variables, on every target a test can execute on, and again after the rows
# render in another shape: testdata/slot_content_handler_reads_its_loop.txtar
# is the code.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output {
    go {
        bubbletea
        fyne
        gtk4
    }
    kotlin {
        android
    }
    none {
        html
    }
}

component card(content ...component node) node {
    var open = 0
    vbox {
        button(text="t {open}", @click { open = open + 1 })
        content
    }
}

component main node {
    var rows = [["a", "b"], ["c"]]
    var log = ""
    var shown = true
    vbox {
        button #swap(text="swap", @click { rows = [["d"], ["e", "f", "g"]] })
        for var row = rows {
            card {
                for var i, it = row {
                    button #cell(text=it, @click { log = "{i}{it}" })
                    button #mark(text=it, @click {
                        var s = "!"
                        log = "{it}{s}{row.map(func(x string) => x + "").length()}"
                    })
                }
            }
        }
        if shown {
            button #tag(text="x{log}", @click {
                var s = "q"
                log = log + s
            })
        }
        text(value=log)
    }
}

func testHandlerReadsItsContentsLoop(t Test, c main) {
    c.cell[1][0].click()
    t.assert(c.log == "0c")
    c.cell[0][1].click()
    t.assert(c.log == "1b")
    c.swap.click()
    c.cell[1][2].click()
    t.assert(c.log == "2g")
    c.mark[1][1].click()
    t.assert(c.log == "f!3")
    if c.tag != null {
        c.tag.click()
    }
    t.assert(c.log == "f!3q")
}

window {
    main
}
